title: Human Body
subtitle: Organs and Their Functions
keyConcept: The human body is made of organs that work together to keep us alive and healthy.
quickFact: Your heart beats about 100,000 times every day!
explanation: Each organ in your body has a special job. Your eyes help you see, your ears help you hear, your nose helps you smell, and your skin helps you feel. These organs work together so you can experience the world around you.
example: When you smell food, your nose sends signals to your brain. Your brain then tells your stomach to get ready for food!
remember: Organs work together as a team to keep your body healthy.

title: Digestive Journey
subtitle: How Food Travels Through Your Body
keyConcept: The digestive system helps process food so the body can use needed substances.
quickFact: Food takes about 6-8 hours to travel through your stomach and small intestine!
explanation: When you eat, food travels through a long tube called the digestive system. It starts at your mouth, goes down your esophagus, into your stomach, through your small intestine, then your large intestine, and finally exits through your anus. Each organ helps break down food and absorb nutrients.
example: Mouth → Esophagus → Stomach → Small Intestine → Large Intestine → Anus
remember: The small intestine is where most nutrients are absorbed.

title: Healthy Body
subtitle: Habits for a Strong and Healthy Life
keyConcept: Healthy habits include balanced nutrition, regular physical activity, and good digestive health.
quickFact: Your body needs at least 60 minutes of physical activity every day!
explanation: Keeping your body healthy means eating a variety of nutritious foods, staying active, drinking enough water, and getting enough rest. Healthy food can be delicious! Eating balanced meals with fruits, vegetables, proteins, and grains helps your body grow and stay strong.
example: A balanced plate has vegetables, fruits, protein, and grains. You can also play sports, ride a bike, or dance to stay active.
remember: Balance and variety are the keys to healthy habits.

title: Human Body Systems
subtitle: How Systems Work Together
keyConcept: The human body has multiple systems that work together to keep us alive.
quickFact: Your body has 11 major organ systems!
explanation: The human body is made up of systems like the digestive system, respiratory system, circulatory system, and more. Each system has organs that work together. These systems also work with each other. For example, the digestive system gets nutrients, and the circulatory system delivers those nutrients to the whole body.
example: When you run, your respiratory system brings in oxygen, your circulatory system pumps it to your muscles, and your digestive system provides energy from food.
remember: All body systems work together as one team.
